list.name: host
list.query: SELECT hostname FROM nodes WHERE grafana_group_visible('${__user.email}', owner_group_id) ORDER BY hostname ASC;

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(a.unixtime) AS time, COALESCE(n.hostname, a.hostname) AS hostname, a.severity, a.alert_type FROM alerts a JOIN nodes n ON a.host_identifier = n.host_identifier WHERE n.hostname IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND a.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND grafana_group_visible('${__user.email}', n.owner_group_id) ORDER BY a.unixtime DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT m.hostname, m.cve_id, m.software_name, m.cvss3_severity AS severity FROM mv_software_cve_flat m JOIN nodes n ON lower(n.host_identifier) = lower(m.host_identifier) WHERE m.hostname IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND m.cvss3_severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND grafana_group_visible('${__user.email}', n.owner_group_id) LIMIT 100;
